parameters.jsCode: const requests=$("List the profile attachments").all(),summary=$("Collect the matching profile emails").first().json;if(!Number.isInteger($runIndex)||$runIndex<0||$runIndex>=requests.length)throw new Error("Invalid profile part index");if($json.ok!==true||typeof $json.ts!=="string"||!/^\d+\.\d+$/.test($json.ts)||$json.channel!==summary.channelId)throw new Error("Slack did not confirm the requested channel; a message may already exist");return {json:{part:requests[$runIndex].json.index,profile:summary.profile,emails:summary.emails,pullRequestsScanned:summary.pullRequestsScanned,commitsScanned:summary.commitsScanned,message:$json}};
